title: Pioneers of Semiconductor Non-Volatile Memory: The First Four Decades
lineage: CHM dates the Masuoka NAND description to 1987 IEDM, describes Toshiba camera division funding, and dates 16-Mbit NAND production to 1992. Flash memory existed before NAND.
